scope: 105 public synthetic development cases for policy alignment only; NOT fresh holdout, model predictions, accuracy proof or a release evaluation. Inputs are deliberately exposed before implementation.
priority: Assess whether the intended message is sufficiently specified, including explicit reply/title/command context and genuine standalone reactions.
Default incomplete messages withhold both judgments. This is a product deferral, not a claim that every visible word is grammatically wrong.
For sufficiently specified messages, assess original target use and original grammar separately; known target error can coexist with grammar uncertainty about a safe correction.
Only equivalent minimal alternatives are interchangeable; alternatives that choose a missing time/sense/participant interpretation require clarification.
Do not convert a model/network/format failure into a grammar judgment.
